title: DNA Warehousing Support (Commercial Warehousing, Storage and Logistics Support)
description: Request for quotations under simplified commercial procedures (FAR 13.5) from NSWC Dahlgren for commercial warehousing, physical storage, inventory management, material handling and freight support for operating materials and equipment at CDSA Dam Neck in the Hampton Roads, VA area. 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses; quotes accepted only from SBA-certified SDVOSBs under NAICS 493110 (size standard $34.0M). Lowest price technically acceptable award; firm-fixed-price commercial contract.
